DividendEvent.description:
One discrete cash dividend.

Time is a year fraction on the same basis as `time_to_expiry_years`, not a
calendar date. The contract carries no calendar, day-count convention or
timezone, and introducing one here to express a dividend date would add a
basis the rest of the contract does not have and cannot validate. The
engine's own `DividendEvent` is `ex_time_years` for the same reason.

cash_amount.description: Cash amount per share, in the same currency as spot and strike.

ex_time_years.description: Ex-dividend time as a year fraction from valuation.

EngineIdentity.description: Service-owned engine provenance, independent of any engine's Rust types.

ExerciseStyle.description: Contract exercise convention, independent of the pricing algorithm.

FusedAnalyticsRequest.description:
A request for price and Greeks, optionally at a volatility solved from an
observed premium first.

With `market_price`, volatility is solved and the Greeks are evaluated at
the solved value — one admission, one solve, and the solved point passed
inward as verified evidence rather than re-derived. Without it, the
supplied `volatility` is used and the result is the all-ten-Greeks
operation under another name.

market_price.description: The observed premium to invert before evaluating the Greeks.

FusedAnalyticsResponse.description: Successful response for one fused-analytics operation.

FusedAnalyticsResult.description:
Price, Greeks and — when a premium was supplied — the solve that produced
the volatility they were evaluated at.

oneOf.description: Present only when the request supplied `market_price`.

GreeksAllTen.description:
The ten Greeks, on the contract's stated bases.

Time derivatives are **per year**. The engine reports them per calendar
day, which embeds a 365-day calendar; the contract carries no calendar,
so the service scales by the engine's own day count at this boundary and
the caller applies whichever convention it holds. Vega is raw `dV/dσ` per
unit volatility, not per point. Nothing else is rescaled.

GreeksAllTenRequest.description:
A request for the price and all ten Greeks at a supplied volatility.

The same shape as `PriceRequest`: the Greeks are derivatives of the
price, so they are a property of the same contract and the same
coordinates.

dividend_schedule.description:
Accepted by the wire contract, refused by this operation until the
engine exposes schedule-aware Greeks without a premium (#330). A
schedule is served on `FusedAnalytics` with `market_price`.

GreeksAllTenResponse.description: Successful response for one all-ten-Greeks operation.

GreeksAllTenResult.description: The price and Greeks of one contract at the volatility supplied.

ImpliedVolatilityRequest.description:
A request to invert an observed premium into a volatility.

Carries `market_price` and no `volatility`: volatility is the unknown being
solved for, so a request that supplied one would be asking the service to
ignore it.

ImpliedVolatilityResponse.description: Successful response for one implied-volatility operation.

ImpliedVolatilityResult.description: A solved implied volatility and the diagnostics that qualify it.

implied_volatility.description: Decimal fraction, on the same basis as `PriceRequest.volatility`.

used_fallback.description:
Whether the solve left its primary path.

Not a quality signal on its own: an American solve inverts by bisection
and reports `true` for every live solve, while a Bachelier solve reports
`false` because bisection is its canonical solver rather than a degraded
fallback.

PolicyResponseMetadata.description: Pinned policy identity and contributing record versions nested in response metadata.

plan.description: Versioned plan reference, formatted as id@version.

records.description: Contributing versioned records in resolution precedence order.

revision.description: Full opaque revision, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

PriceRequest.description: A single option-pricing request. All numeric fields are required.

dividend_schedule.description:
Discrete cash dividends within the option's life. American
Bjerksund-Stensland 2002 only; omit for continuous `dividend_yield` alone.

model_version.description: Optional algorithm-version pin. Omit to use the current version.

PriceResponse.description: Successful response for one pricing operation.

PriceResult.description: The transport-neutral result of one pricing operation.

model_version.description: Stable revision of the selected pricing algorithm.

PricingModel.description: Pricing algorithm selection. `Auto` resolves from the exercise style.

RegimeBasis.description: What the model predicts, not a claim that a reference fit ran on this request.

RegimeConsumedPriceRange.description:
Contiguous half-open range in the caller's original price array. Only this
range enters inference; every supplied price is validated before cropping.

end_index_exclusive.description: Exclusive original-array index; equals received_price_count in V1.

prediction.description: Tie priority: unresolved, unsupported, supported, not_eligible (first wins).

scores.description:
Every allowed label occurs exactly once. Array order has no meaning.
Serialized values satisfy abs(sum(scores[*].value) - 1) <= 1e-12
separately for each available prediction. The selected label
maximizes the serialized scores; ties use the documented label priority.

RegimeHead_RegimeDecisionPrediction.description:
Shared envelope for all heads. Available has a prediction and no reason_code.
Basis is required for every status. Other statuses require prediction:null
and a stable reason_code. A predicted
unresolved decision is available, unlike an unavailable head. Whole-request
runtime failures use the ordinary non-200 error envelope, not a synthetic label.

prediction.description: Tie priority: NEUTRAL, DOWN, UP (first wins). NEUTRAL is a valid tendency, never missing data.

scores.description:
Every allowed label occurs exactly once. Array order has no meaning.
Serialized values satisfy abs(sum(scores[*].value) - 1) <= 1e-12
separately for each available prediction. The selected label
maximizes the serialized scores; ties use the documented label priority.

RegimeHead_RegimeDirectionPrediction.description:
Shared envelope for all heads. Available has a prediction and no reason_code.
Basis is required for every status. Other statuses require prediction:null
and a stable reason_code. A predicted
unresolved decision is available, unlike an unavailable head. Whole-request
runtime failures use the ordinary non-200 error envelope, not a synthetic label.

prediction.description: Tie priority: HIGHER_VOL, LOWER_VOL (first wins). Ordering is relative within the target fit, not historical volatility levels.

scores.description:
Every allowed label occurs exactly once. Array order has no meaning.
Serialized values satisfy abs(sum(scores[*].value) - 1) <= 1e-12
separately for each available prediction. The selected label
maximizes the serialized scores; ties use the documented label priority.

RegimeHead_RegimeStatePrediction.description:
Shared envelope for all heads. Available has a prediction and no reason_code.
Basis is required for every status. Other statuses require prediction:null
and a stable reason_code. A predicted
unresolved decision is available, unlike an unavailable head. Whole-request
runtime failures use the ordinary non-200 error envelope, not a synthetic label.

all_prices_consumed.description:
True iff consumed_price_range covers [0, received_price_count).
False means intentional contiguous truncation of the oldest prefix only,
never invalid-price removal or incomplete processing. Always false in V1.

as_of.description:
Final price timestamp supplied by the caller, or null when unknown.
Null never means the HTTP response time.

engines.description:
Library that executed inference. Version and revision come from the
released dependency pin; model weights are identified by provenance.
Does not include reference fitting engines that did not execute.

inference_time_us.description:
Monotonic elapsed microseconds, truncated to an integer. Starts after
acquiring the model lock and committing admission, before selecting the
input slice; ends immediately after predict returns its heads. Includes
slice selection, preprocessing, tensors, inference, output extraction,
softmax and head construction/gating. Excludes loading, admission/queue,
metadata construction, serialization, HTTP and network time.

input_price_index.description:
Original-array price index at the selected return's end:
consumed_price_range.start_index + observation_index + 1.

observation_index.description:
Zero-based return index within consumed_price_range: 505. Return i uses
original prices[start_index + i] and prices[start_index + i + 1].

price_count.description: Number of prices actually consumed by inference.

received_price_count.description: Number of prices received before cropping.

window_price_count.description:
Intermediate public window size: always 512, covering original indices
[received_price_count - 512, received_price_count). Not the consumed count.

RegimeProvenance.description: Pinned served artifact identity; no request-time reference fitting is implied.

model_id.description:
Immutable identity covering weights, preprocessing, reference procedure
and label definitions; see the REGIME_MODEL_V1.md identity record.

model_sha256.description:
Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact served student.onnx file bytes, not the
training checkpoint, manifest, runtime binary or response.

preprocessing.description: Supplemental preprocessing identity; explicit return semantics are in metadata.

RegimeRequest.description:
At least 512 comparable positive prices, ordered oldest to newest.
No sampling interval is supplied, inferred or assumed.
Longer arrays are cropped to the latest 512; inference uses that window's
latest 507 prices. Every supplied price must be finite and positive.
The encoded request body is limited to 32 KiB (policy may narrow this).
Corporate-action adjustment is the caller's responsibility; the V1 model
was trained on split-adjusted closes, without cash-dividend total-return adjustment.

as_of.description:
Timestamp of the final supplied price, echoed unchanged. Never inferred
from the server clock. RFC 3339 with an explicit UTC offset.

RegimeScoreContract.description:
Applies separately to every available head; never multiply heads or interpret
their scores as a joint probability. Identifies score semantics, not calibration.

sum_tolerance.description:
For each available prediction, using serialized values:
abs(sum(prediction.scores[*].value) - 1) <= sum_tolerance.

value.description: Finite score in [0,1]; not a calibrated probability.
Finite score in [0,1]; not a calibrated probability.

label.description:
Volatility relative to the other state in the reference Markov model, not
historical norms. Fixed Student-t degrees of freedom make scale ordering
identical to standard-deviation ordering. Neither label indicates direction.

value.description: Finite score in [0,1]; not a calibrated probability.

RegimeStateLabel.description:
Volatility relative to the other state in the reference Markov model, not
historical norms. Fixed Student-t degrees of freedom make scale ordering
identical to standard-deviation ordering. Neither label indicates direction.

ResidualBasis.description:
The basis a solved residual is expressed in.

The residual is not one quantity. European and Black paths report a
forward-normalised price residual comparable against the engine's
convergence threshold; Bachelier and American Bjerksund-Stensland report a
raw option-price residual. Publishing the number without its basis would
invite exactly the cross-model comparison it does not support, so the basis
travels with it and a client that ignores this field cannot silently get it
wrong.

ResolvedPricingModel.description:
Pricing algorithm selected after resolving an input request.

Unlike [`PricingModel`], this output-only type cannot represent `auto`.

ResponseMetadata.description: Metadata shared by every successful response and API error.

budget_reset_at.description: UTC end of the budget period from the pinned account snapshot, when known.

engine_version.description: Version of the operation's primary engine (legacy compatibility field).

engines.description:
Engines selected for this operation, including their released Git revisions.
Does not assert execution on pre-execution failures.

fcu_charged.description:
Committed commercial charge, including on post-commit failures.
Absent in open development mode; zero for protected pre-commit refusals.

fcu_quoted.description: Commercial quote; absent until reservation succeeds.

remaining_fcu_instance_estimate.description: Instance estimate, never an authoritative account balance or authorization input.

ServiceErrorEnvelope.description:
Errors for the regime route and router-level 404/405 refusals. No model or
engine execution is claimed, including before authentication and on timeout.

ServiceErrorMetadata.description:
Regime and router error metadata. Identifies the service, not a numerical
engine. Commercial evidence is included only when admission supplies it.
